sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Troubleshooting is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Troubleshooting skill facilitates rectification of weapon malfunctions.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases troubleshooting speed (0.5% per level → +25% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Malfunction type identification doesn't require weapon examination.
- Elite level: Reduces the chance of malfunctions from a magazine by 50% after fixing a malfunction caused by the same reason
- Elite level: Reduces the chance of malfunctions based on the durability of weapons by 50% after fixing a malfunction caused by the same reason
- Elite level: Reduces the chance of malfunctions from a cartridge by 50% after fixing a malfunction caused by the same reason

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Fixing Weapon malfunctions
- Completing the quest Psycho Sniper
- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
- Completing the quest Goals and Means
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
